payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel, 28×28 RGB MedMNIST distribution) loaded with split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) matching official sizes exactly; no subsampling. Archive MD5/SHA256 verified and consistent. Selected-index SHA256 hashes present for all three splits, providing full traceability. License CC BY 4.0 is appropriate. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is correctly flagged as an OOD/domain-shift consideration for downstream evaluation; it does not constitute an ingestion error. No deterministic findings were raised. One minor traceability observation: llm_model_digest is null in the run manifest while llm_model is set to 'qwen3.8' via ollama. This does not affect data ingestion integrity, but if the LLM participates in later stages (e.g., augmentation selection, hyperparameter search), the absence of a model digest weakens full reproducibility. Recommend populating the digest before the first training stage. No blocking issues; proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null despite llm_model='qwen3.8' being specified; populate before training stages to ensure full reproducibility of any LLM-in-the-loop decisions.
